newsitem.title: MEXICO: Quadrum approves spin off of leasing unit.
newsitem.headline: Quadrum approves spin off of leasing unit.

text.p: Mexican financial group Banca Quadrum S.A. said on Wednesday that its shareholders approved the spin-off of its 60 percent stake in car leasing unit FerroQuadrum.
In a statement, the company said shareholders will receive new shares in the new company, called Actium. The new firm will also raise new capital worth 360 million pesos.

The company had said earlier the fresh capital would be raised either by cash payment for new shares by current Quadrum shareholders or through a primary offering in the Mexican Stock Exchange and on the Nasdaq National Market System.
Quadrum shareholders will receive an Actium ADR for each Quadrum ADR they currently hold, worth one B and L series shares on the Mexican bourse.
Quadrum said it wanted to spin off its leasing company to allow it to grow more quickly.
